name: RankBolt
summary: AI SEO platform that writes and publishes articles to WordPress, Webflow or Shopify, tracks keyword rankings and monitors how AI engines mention your brand, for site owners and agencies.
best_for: site owners and small agencies that want AI-written SEO articles, rank tracking and AI-search visibility reports in one subscription with auto-publishing
skip_if: you want to pay in dollars or euros, need a permanent free plan, or want proof of ranking results before you pay
honest_knock: Prices are in Swiss francs, so a US or EU buyer pays a converted amount, and we could not read the yearly amounts behind the "-17%" toggle. The free trial is only 3 days. The charts on the homepage are labelled illustrative, so they are not evidence of ranking results.

pricing.notes: (read 2026-11-06 on rankbolt.ai) RankBolt prices in Swiss francs and sells three monthly plans, each with a 3-day free trial that, per the page, needs no credit card. Starter costs 69 CHF a month for 1 connected site, 10 published SEO articles, 25 tracked keywords checked weekly and 20 AI prompts tracked daily across 4 engines. Pro costs 149 CHF a month for 3 sites, 30 articles, 50 keywords checked daily and 75 AI prompts. Agency costs 299 CHF a month for 10 sites, 60 articles, 100 keywords and 175 AI prompts. Add-ons: an extra site costs 19 CHF a month, 25 more daily AI prompts 45 CHF a month and 10 more articles 15 CHF a month. A Yearly toggle on the page says -17%, but we did not read the yearly amounts. Every plan includes publishing to WordPress, Webflow, Shopify and Wix, a site audit and an MCP server and API. The page says there are no per-seat fees; it does not say whether Swiss VAT is included. Custom volume pricing is available for more than ten sites.
